# Toledo Technologies

Toledo Technologies LLC is a remote software practice. It publishes fixed
prices for bounded work instead of quoting after a discovery call.

Delivery is AI-operated and disclosed before an engagement starts, not after.
Correspondence, implementation, testing and handover are run by AI within the
written scope, with the company accountable for delivery. Human review is
included only when the scope names the reviewer and that review is actually
performed. Toledo Technologies LLC is the contracting supplier either way.

Engagements and quotes: dev@toledotechnologies.com
Everything else: hello@toledotechnologies.com
Full vendor record, including description text you may reuse verbatim:
https://toledotechnologies.com/listing/
Machine-readable catalogue (schema.org JSON-LD):
https://toledotechnologies.com/catalog.json

## Fixed-scope engagements — published price, published boundary, published refund

- File conversion — US$850, bought directly at
  https://toledotechnologies.com/buy/file-conversion/ without emailing first.
  One source format, one target schema, up to 50,000 rows. Every input row
  appears in the output or in a reject list with a reason; the counts reconcile
  or the run fails. Delivered within two business days of receiving both the
  file and the target schema. Paid up front — paying is acceptance of the scope
  on that page — and refunded in full if the file cannot be read or the
  conversion falls outside that scope. Excludes access to live systems,
  scheduled runs, data cleaning beyond the stated conversion, and any legal,
  tax, accounting or regulatory opinion on the data.

- Integration triage — US$1,200, refunded in full if the failure cannot be
  reproduced. Diagnosis only; the repair is quoted separately. Scoped in
  writing first and paid after the agreed acceptance test passes.

- Reproducible test or evaluation harness — US$2,200. Scores from saved
  outputs, byte-stable, re-derivable offline. It does not re-run the system
  under test. Scoped in writing first and paid after the agreed acceptance test
  passes. No separate refund condition is published for this one; payment falls
  due only after acceptance.

Prices are US dollars and exclude tax applicable in the buyer's jurisdiction.
The payment rule is not the same for all three: file conversion is bought up
front, the other two are paid on acceptance.
Details: https://toledotechnologies.com/engagements/

## Bad fit, stated plainly
- Call-heavy work. Delivery is written and asynchronous; no standups, no live
  debugging sessions.
- Regulatory certification. No accessibility conformance statements, security
  attestations, or clinical or financial sign-off are issued.
- Undefined problems. A fixed price is the wrong instrument and we will say so.
- Platforms with no track record here. We say so rather than learn on a budget.

## What is actually worked with
Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node, SQL, shell. Astro for static sites.
CSV, TSV, fixed-width, JSON, XML, Excel output; schema mapping; reconciliation
against a source of truth; deduplication with a stated policy.
REST and webhook integration, request signing, retry and idempotency behaviour,
failure queues, API debugging against real traffic.
Automated test suites, reproducible evaluation harnesses, failure-path testing.

## Evidence
Two runnable samples with full source, test records and stated limits:
https://toledotechnologies.com/proofs/
They use invented data and are demonstrations of method, not client references.
The pages say so themselves. A passing sample does not establish that any
merchant's system has been repaired.

## Larger project work
Separate from the fixed-scope catalogue above. Scoped and priced per project,
entered through paid discovery rather than a fixed order.
- ToledoWeb — $5,500 – $250,000+
- SiteLift WordPress-exit migration — $3,500 – $65,000+
- Toledo Apps — $15,000 – $750,000+
- Toledo Mobile — native $50,000+, cross-platform $65,000+
- Toledo AI — $10,000 – $300,000+
- Care plans — Hearth Care from $750/month for static sites, Olympian Care from
  $10,000/month for fractional engineering

Paid discovery, charged 100% upfront. Six products:
- SiteLift Fit Check — $750 fixed
- Website Migration Audit — $1,500 fixed
- Web App Discovery (Delphi App Discovery) — $3,500 – $5,000
- AI Automation Blueprint — $3,500 – $10,000
- Mobile App Discovery (Delphi Mobile Discovery) — $5,000 – $7,500
- SaaS / Product Strategy — $7,500 – $15,000

For a qualifying project started within 30 days, 50% of the discovery fee is
credited to the kickoff Project Retainer. The credit is capped at that retainer;
unused credit lapses and does not roll forward. The discovery document remains
usable whether or not Toledo is hired for implementation.
- Service overview: https://toledotechnologies.com/services
- Discovery routing: https://toledotechnologies.com/discovery/#start
- Mobile discovery: https://mobile.toledotechnologies.com/#discovery
- AI discovery: https://ai.toledotechnologies.com/#start

## White-label subcontracting for agencies
Priced hourly, unlike everything above: $125/hour floor, $150–$175/hour for
complex work, partner retainers from $2,500/month. Agreements can include
non-solicitation boundaries and written IP assignment terms.
https://toledotechnologies.com/partner

## Toledo-operated software
- Tessera free bounded evidence check — no account
- PCI DSS 6.4.3 written remediation pack — $299 once
- PCI DSS 5.4.1 email-authentication remediation pack — $99 once
- PCI DSS 11.6.1 one-target evidence ledger — $99/month, evaluated every 72 hours

Tessera reports bounded software-generated evidence for qualified human review;
it does not determine PCI DSS compliance. Public synthetic samples are available
before checkout: https://qi.toledotechnologies.com/pci-4-compliance-scanner

Free MIT served-HTML inventory Action (does not execute JavaScript or certify
compliance): https://github.com/ntoledo319/pci-payment-page-check
GitHub Marketplace: https://github.com/marketplace/actions/pci-payment-page-script-check
Reviewer-owned inventory template:
https://qi.toledotechnologies.com/pci/pci-dss-6-4-3-script-inventory-template

## Evidence labels
- Field notes identify independent public research and its limitations.
- Sample deliverables are labeled as samples and are not presented as client work.
- A public research note is not automatically a paid client engagement or a
  promised outcome.

## What Toledo does not have
No published client references or named case studies. No third-party reviews or
ratings on any review platform. No security, accessibility, clinical or
financial certifications. No published D-U-N-S number, CAGE code or federal
contractor registration. One operator, AI-operated delivery, disclosed.

The nonprofit track at https://toledotechnologies.com/nonprofit does trade
reduced pricing for a written case study and a short testimonial. Nothing
collected that way is an independent review, and none is published today.

## Reuse
The description text at https://toledotechnologies.com/listing/ may be
reproduced verbatim by any directory, index, registry or writer without asking.
If a price is quoted, keep its boundary, its refund condition and its payment
timing attached to it.
